title: Touriste anglophone perdu
notes: Conversation synthétique de test, jamais un appel réel.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, I am staying in your guesthouse. I lost my passport and I am frightened.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Could you tell me how to reach the police station? I need help quickly.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am not asking you to send money. I will go to the station myself and speak with the officers.
